system.description:
Peculiar Photos: its photos capture astral-plane enemies, spirits and secrets the naked eye can't see. Flash Bulb: for an instant everyone can see what the camera sees, and a spirit caught in the flash is Stunned.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.159
system.summary: Peculiar Photos: its photos capture astral-plane enemies, spirits and secrets the naked eye can't see. Flash Bulb: for an instant everyone can see what the camera sees, and a spirit caught in the flash is Stunned.

automation.note: Flash Bulb: target only spirits caught in the flash before using it; they are Stunned with no check. Clear your targets to just take a photo. The Director describes what the photo reveals.
